scripts.build: npm run wasm:build && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:test-worker: npm run wasm:build && tsc --noEmit && BAIYUE_TEST_HARNESS=1 vite build --outDir dist-worker-test
scripts.test:worker: npm run build:test-worker && BAIYUE_WORKER_TEST=1 playwright test tests/gameplay-worker.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:persistence: npm run build:test-worker && BAIYUE_WORKER_TEST=1 playwright test tests/gameplay-persistence.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:performance: npm run build:test-worker && BAIYUE_WORKER_TEST=1 playwright test tests/gameplay-performance.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:smoke: playwright test tests/gameplay-e2e.spec.ts tests/debug-panel.spec.ts tests/global-lighting.spec.ts tests/render-fallback.spec.ts
